draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.81, the 205th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 24th of 37 at CB. He went 197th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1 interceptions in 2018, 19th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.
